issue.title: Post-Initialize: prompt to create a GitHub repo (don't bury it in Settings)

successCriteria.description: After initializing a blank folder, the user is prompted to create a GitHub repo; accepting writes 'gh repo create --source=. --remote=origin' to the terminal.
Declining is a clean no-op; with no active terminal a helpful toast appears instead of a silent failure; the existing add-a-valid-project path is unchanged.

phases.title: Add a post-Initialize 'create a GitHub repo?' prompt to ProjectsSection
phases.content: In apps/desktop/src/components/sidebar/ProjectsSection.tsx, extend the Initialize flow added in #285 (the branch that runs invoke('init_tiki_project') after the user confirms 'Initialize Tiki here?'). AFTER init_tiki_project + switch_project + addProject succeed, proactively prompt: window.confirm('Tiki initialized. Create a GitHub repo for this project now?'). On DECLINE: clean no-op (project is already set up locally). On ACCEPT: hand off to the terminal exactly like GreenfieldChecklist.tsx's createRemote Fix (#287) — write 'gh repo create --source=. --remote=origin\n' to the active terminal and switch to the terminal view. REUSE the established pattern: study how GreenfieldChecklist.tsx writes to the terminal (its local writeToActiveTerminal equivalent — reads the terminal store's active terminal and invoke('write_terminal', {id, data}), returns null when none) and how useCommandActions.ts:18 does it. If there is NO active terminal for the project (the write returns null), show a helpful toast via useToastStore (e.g. 'Open a terminal (Start Claude), then create the repo from Settings → readiness checklist') instead of failing silently. OPTIONAL (nice-to-have, only if clean): preflight by reading the just-init'd project — but do not over-engineer; the gh command itself will prompt for auth in the terminal if needed (the checklist's auth-first guard already covers the Settings path). Keep ALL existing conventions: per-action pending in component useState (no fresh-ref / store-selector), the existing isInitializing flow, and leave the valid-project path untouched. This is a small, self-contained addition to the existing init branch.
